title: Owlproject.org needs your support.
description: The 2019 Annual Art Project is... a 3D Owl Puzzle!
html:
Our NPO owlproject.org has been busy with the learners in township schools across Gauteng coming up with ideas for the next Owl Day Art Project! This year, the kids chose a 3D Owl Puzzle!

Owlproject.org has been raising funds to create 50 Owl Puzzles for learners in township schools. They have received a wonderful response but just need a little bit more help to reach their goal!

The owl puzzle has 34 pieces and is 35 cm tall. Each unit costs R500.00 to create. This cost includes the laser cutting fee, colouring pencils and travel fees.

The 3D Owl Puzzles will be showcased - with the previous years' artwork - at Birdlife SAs Bird Fair on the 14-15 September 2019 at the Walter Sisulu Botanical Gardens.

To support the schools and turn the children's dream to reality, please use the banking details below or head to their website here for other easy ways to sponsor a 3D Owl Puzzle! Your name will be placed on the Owl Puzzle in recognition of your support for the 2019 Owl Art Project.

Bank and Account Type: Nedbank Current Account
Branch Name: Central Gauteng
Account Number: 1120438225
Branch Code: 12840500
Swift Code: NEDSZAJJ

Your support will enable owlproject.org to create owl friendly children who go on to be owl friendly adults, living within an owl friendly environment. We firmly believe that through education, there is conservation.

For for information, you are welcome to drop Delina Chipape a mail on info@owlproject.org or call 076 360 9072.
